messages:
Maria Chen: Kicking off a short thread to align on long-term routing, multi-region tenant isolation, and launch gating. Need clear Phase 1 vs Phase 2 scope.
Alex Rivera: +1. Fintech customer keeps pushing for region pinning + audit trails; want to understand minimal deliverable.
Chris Patel: Suggest we categorize routing policies: latency-affinity, cost-aware routing, and compliance pinning. Each maps to different infra changes.
Samir Gupta: For a minimal Phase 1 we can do: soft region affinity (best-effort), tenant labels + metadata, routing fallback policies, and basic audit logs. Hard pinning stays Phase 2.
Alex Rivera: Customers really want hard pinning. Can we quantify the blockers for moving pinning into Phase 1?
Chris Patel: Blockers are affinity state store design, consistency guarantees across regions for control plane, migration state machine, and capacity planning for pinned placements. Also testing and rollout playbook.
Maria Chen: Proposed launch criteria for Phase 1: published SLO targets (p95 latency delta <=15% for affinity traffic), audit log retention + export, and a documented migration runbook. For Phase 2 add: hard pinning SLA, KMS-backed audit chain, and migration tooling with <5m impact window.
Samir Gupta: Rough infra estimate: affinity state + control APIs (2 sprints), routing mesh + selector changes (3 sprints), migration tooling (2 sprints), testing/canary (2 sprints) = ~9 sprints. Add buffer for perf work.
Alex Rivera: Commercial suggestion: make hard pinning + extended audit logs an enterprise add-on. Offer pilots to early-adopter customers.
Chris Patel: Ops considerations: isolation lanes for noisy tenants, per-lane quotas, SLA-aware routing. Need preflight checks and capacity accounting to avoid overcommit.
Maria Chen: Risk register items: cross-region failover edge cases, double-billing during migrations, cache-warmup cold starts for pinned replicas. We'll record mitigation plans.
Samir Gupta: I'll draft runbooks for soft eviction and tenant migration rollback. Also include metrics we gate on.
Chris Patel: Gate metrics we must include in RFC: migration success rate >=99%, no production latency regressions >10% for pinned traffic, and canary pass rate >=95%.
Alex Rivera: I'll add customer ask catalog and sample SLA text for the RFC. We should tie pricing to predictable capacity impact.
Maria Chen: Owner: Maria. Reviewers: Alex, Chris, Samir. Target RFC draft by end of next week. Will paste link here when uploaded. :rocket:
infra-bot: deployment-check: config branch "routing-affinity-rfc" has no blocking deploy issues :white_check_mark:
Maria Chen: Thanks team. Once RFC is up we'll schedule a 30m sync to finalize phase definitions and launch checklist.
